title: Level specification (.gamestudio/levels/*.level.json)
description: One level: mechanics used, layout (a grid, a typed puzzle layout, or a generator reference), goals, limits, obstacles, difficulty target, solver / bot results and its role in the teach-test-twist-reward rhythm. puzzle_solver.py solves layout.type sliding, sokoban, sort and lights_out; layout.type match3 is the suggested input shape for match3_sim.py.

cell.description: One grid cell: a short code ("#" wall, "." floor, "r" red), a number, or null for no cell.

matrix.description: Row-major grid: an array of rows, each an array of cells; row 0 is the top row.

rows.description: Row-major grid as strings, one character per cell; row 0 is the top row.

grid_array.description: Bare grid: rows as arrays of cells or as strings. Equivalent to {"type": "grid", "grid": ...}.

layout_grid.description: Generic tile grid with a legend (board games, tower-defense paths, custom puzzles).

rows.description: Cells as strings, one character per cell.

legend.description: Meaning of each cell code, e.g. {"#": "wall", "P": "enemy path", ".": "buildable"}.

layout_sliding.description: Sliding-tile puzzle (15-puzzle family). 0 is the blank; a move slides an adjacent tile into the blank.

grid.description: Start state as rows of integers, 0 = blank; all rows the same length.

goal.description: Goal state; default is 1..N-1 in reading order with the blank last.

layout_sokoban.description: Sokoban puzzle in the common XSB text notation.

rows.description: Rows using '#' wall, '@' player, '+' player on goal, '$' box, '*' box on goal, '.' goal, ' ' / '-' / '_' floor. Exactly one player; boxes = goals.

layout_sort.description: Sort puzzle (ball / water / nut sort). Each tube is a stack listed bottom to top. A move takes the top run of same-colour items from one tube onto an empty tube or onto a top item of the same colour, within capacity. Solved when every non-empty tube holds capacity items of one colour.

capacity.description: Items per tube when full (4 is the genre standard).

items.description: One tube, bottom item first. Empty array = empty tube. Length must not exceed capacity.

tubes.description: All tubes including empty ones. Each colour should appear exactly capacity times.

pour.description: Move rule: "max" moves as many matching top items as fit (water-sort standard), "single" moves one item per move (ball-sort variant).

colors.description: Optional list of colour codes used, for validation and rendering.

layout_lights_out.description: Lights Out: pressing a cell toggles it and its orthogonal neighbours; solved when all cells are 0.

width.description: Board width in cells (when the board is fully random).

rows.description: Board as strings: '.' random tile, '#' hole, letters for fixed colours or obstacle codes defined in legend.

grid.description: Board as a matrix of cell codes.

colors.description: Number of tile colours; each extra colour lowers match odds sharply (5 or 6 is typical).

legend.description: Meaning of non-colour codes, e.g. {"B": "box (1 hp)", "I": "ice"}.

layout_generator.description: Layout produced on demand by a generator; the seed makes it reproducible.

generator.description: Generator reference, e.g. "pcg.py wfc" or an engine-side generator id.

layout_custom.description: Anything else; tools that do not know the format skip it.

format.description: Name of the custom format and the tool that reads it.

layout_object.description: Typed layout; the type field selects the variant and its required fields.

goal.description: A win condition: a description string or an object.

target.description: What to collect / clear / reach (item or obstacle code), if any.

level_id.description: Level id, e.g. "w1_l012" or "bonus_005"; also the level_id analytics parameter.

mechanic_refs.description: Ids of contract mechanics this level uses; a level should introduce at most one new mechanic.

layout.description: Level layout: a bare grid (array of rows) or a typed layout object whose type is grid, sliding, sokoban, sort, lights_out, match3, generator or custom.

goals.description: Win conditions; all must be met unless notes say otherwise.

moves_or_time_limit.description: Limit: an integer move limit, an object {"moves": n} and/or {"time_sec": s}, or null for unlimited.

obstacles.description: Obstacles and blockers: codes or objects such as {"type": "ice", "cells": [[2,3]], "hp": 2}.

difficulty_target.description: Designed difficulty, compared against solver and bot results.

win_rate.description: Target first-attempt win rate of an average player.

solver.description: Results written by puzzle_solver.py / match3_sim.py. Leave fields null until a tool has run.

solvable.description: Whether a solution exists under the move limit (null = not yet checked).

min_moves.description: Length of the shortest solution found.

bot_win_rate.description: Win rate of the reference bot within the limit, as a ratio.

runs.description: Number of bot runs behind bot_win_rate.

teach.description: Role in the rhythm: teach (introduce safely), test (check mastery), twist (combine or subvert), reward (easy, generous breather).

notes.description: Design intent, the expected solution path and known issues.
